```python
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel

app = FastAPI()

# User model
class User(BaseModel):
    id: int
    username: str
    password: str

# Project model
class Project(BaseModel):
    id: int
    name: str
    description: str

# Label model
class Label(BaseModel):
    id: int
    name: str
    color: str

# Comment model
class Comment(BaseModel):
    id: int
    text: str

# Task model
class Task(BaseModel):
    id: int
    title: str
    description: str
    project_id: int
    labels: list
    comments: list

# Routes
@app.post("/login")
def login(username: str, password: str):
    # Authenticate user
    return {"token": "example_token"}

@app.get("/projects")
def get_projects():
    # Return all projects
    return [{"id": 1, "name": "Project 1"}, {"id": 2, "name": "Project 2"}]

@app.get("/projects/{project_id}/labels")
def get_labels(project_id: int):
    # Return all labels for a project
    return [{"id": 1, "name": "Label 1"}, {"id": 2, "name": "Label 2"}]

@app.get("/projects/{project_id}/tasks")
def get_tasks(project_id: int):
    # Return all tasks for a project
    return [{"id": 1, "title": "Task 1"}, {"id": 2, "title": "Task 2"}]

@app.get("/tasks/{task_id}/comments")
def get_comments(task_id: int):
    # Return all comments for a task
    return [{"id": 1, "text": "Comment 1"}, {"id": 2, "text": "Comment 2"}]
```

# Explanation
- We use the FastAPI framework to create the REST API.
- We define models for users, projects, labels, comments, and tasks using Pydantic's BaseModel.
- We create routes for authentication, getting projects, labels, tasks, and comments.
- Each route returns a simple response, such as a list of projects or a token for authentication.

No extra libraries needed beyond FastAPI and Pydantic, which are imported in the code.
